office: the Passport, Immigration and Citizenship Agency (PICA); abroad, Jamaica's diplomatic missions and consulates

routes.label: regular: 7 working days in Kingston, 11 to 14 elsewhere; the longest is taken
overseas: 20 working days from receipt in Kingston

note: PICA's fee page gives the schedule effective Monday, 1 June 2015 as current; no later change was found on PICA's pages (a commercial site gives higher 2024 figures, not used). Replacement passports cost more (J$11,500 adult, J$7,000 minor, and by rush 14,500, 16,500 and 21,500, or 9,000, 10,000 and 12,000), written as replacement routes. Overseas the table gives US$80 for an adult and US$50 for a minor (US$160 and US$100 to replace one), the abroad routes' currency, and pounds (50 and 30; 100 and 50) in the United Kingdom, which the one abroad currency can't hold.

sources.title: Passport, Immigration and Citizenship Agency (pica.gov.jm), Passport: General Information
sources.said: Jamaican ordinary passports are issued by the Passport Immigration and Citizenship Agency in Jamaica and Jamaican Diplomatic Missions or Consulates and are valid to travel to all countries. Passports issued to persons over 18 years of age are valid for 10 years and those issued to persons under 18 years of age are valid for 5 years, unless otherwise endorsed.
